fy2026_diagnostics.note: Mechanical diagnostics are not normalized owner FCF. Finance/operating leases, working capital, strategic investments and economic maintenance versus growth investment are not fully normalized.

balance_sheet_diagnostic.note: Simple net cash does not net lease commitments or other contractual obligations.

reverse_expectations.method: Retain 2026-09-06 Base year-1 revenue $400B, owner-margin path 14%/16.5%/19%/21.5%/24% then 24%, 25x terminal multiple and 9% required return; solve uniform revenue growth for years 2-10.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: About 11.79% annual growth is demanding for a company of Microsoft's scale but not an unrealistic bull-only condition given current Azure growth. The main uncertainty is whether owner margins recover after the AI infrastructure investment wave.

two_state_price_position.note: Algebraic location only, not an estimated probability.

valuation_conclusion: Current price is about 7.2% above the retained Base value. Price does not require an impossible bull case, but the expectation gap is insufficient while lease-aware incremental ROIC and normalized owner cash remain unresolved.
